declared_schema.description: One of: create, list, update, pause, resume, remove, run, cancel. When action=create, the 'schedule' and 'prompt' fields are REQUIRED.

action.semantics: Dispatches create/list/update/pause/resume/remove/run/cancel; run_now and trigger are run aliases.

approve.semantics: Internal model-boundary flag; direct Python callers omit it.

declared_schema.description: True = the job's delivery is CONTINUABLE — the user can reply and the agent has the brief in context (threads on thread-capable platforms, mirrored into the DM elsewhere). Use for conversational recurring jobs (briefings); leave unset for fire-and-forget alerts. Scope: the job's own conversation only — the origin chat, the home-channel fallback when deliver='origin' captured no origin (script-created jobs), a user-written bare platform target (deliver='slack' — that platform's home channel), or the job's single explicit platform:chat target (this flag is the only way to attach an explicit target). Broadcast targets are never attached; no effect when deliver='local'.

attach_to_session.semantics: Makes an eligible single delivery conversation continuable; broadcast and local are not attached.

base_url.semantics: Operator/programmatic endpoint with credential-origin validation; never forwarded by the model handler.

declared_schema.description: Runs missed while the machine was off: true = run once on return, false = skip. Omit for the default (recurring run once, one-shots skip).

catch_up.semantics: Tri-state missed-run policy; only real booleans or null are accepted by storage.

declared_schema.description: Optional job ID(s) whose most recent completed output is injected as context each run — chains jobs (A collects, B processes). For a job's OWN previous output prefer `continuity`. On update, [] clears.

context_from.semantics: Existing job IDs whose latest completed output is injected; self denotes this job.

declared_schema.description: True = each run sees the job's own previous output, so it can dedupe and continue where it left off (scouts, monitors, incremental digests). Default false. On update, false turns it off.

continuity.semantics: True adds self to context_from; false removes it.

declared_schema.description: Where the job's output is POSTED as a one-way message (the job itself always runs in a fresh session with no chat context). Omit to address the chat/topic this job was created from. Otherwise: 'local' (save only, no delivery), 'all' (every connected home channel, resolved at fire time), 'bot-chat' or 'bot-chat:<profile>' (inject into a Bot Chat as a real message), 'room:<room_id>' (post into a Bot Mode Group Chat; it starts a round only for members the output @mentions), or platform:chat_id:thread_id (e.g. 'telegram:-1001234567890:17585'). Comma-combine like 'origin,all'. From a local chat (CLI, TUI or Desktop) the default writes the result into that chat's history as a note, seen when the chat is reopened and by its next turn, not as a live message.

deliver.semantics: Comma-separated routing tokens resolved by the same scheduler resolver used at run time.

declared_schema.description: Optional toolset names to restrict the job's agent to (e.g. ["web", "terminal"]) — cuts token overhead. Infer from the prompt. Omit for all default tools. [] = an explicit zero-tool allowlist (the job's agent gets no toolsets, MCP servers included unless named); it is preserved as [], never widened back to the default.

enabled_toolsets.semantics: Absent inherits defaults; [] is an explicit zero-tool allowlist.

declared_schema.description: Optional override target for FAILURE notices only (same grammar as deliver). When set, engine failure/interruption notices go here instead of the deliver target; 'local' suppresses them entirely (state still recorded in cron list/run history). Use for jobs delivering into shared channels where failure noise is unwanted. Omit = failures follow deliver (default). On update, '' clears.

failure_deliver.semantics: Optional separate failure lane; empty string clears on update.

grace_minutes.semantics: Cron-only catch-up override in whole minutes from 0 through 1440; 0 is preserved.

include_disabled.semantics: Handler-only list switch; model dispatch defaults it to true.

interpreter.semantics: Operator/programmatic Python interpreter for scripts; absent from the model surface.

declared_schema.description: Required for update/pause/resume/remove/run/cancel.

job_id.semantics: See the frozen shared schema and handler source.

model.semantics: Operator/programmatic inference model; never forwarded by the model handler.

declared_schema.description: Optional change-detector that gates the agent: an http(s) URL (fetched each tick) or a script path (same rules as `script`, run each tick) — cheap, no LLM. Output identical to the previous tick skips the agent run entirely; changed output wakes the agent with a diff injected into the prompt. First tick always runs (baseline). Output must be deterministic (no timestamps) or every tick looks changed. Incompatible with no_agent. On update, '' clears.

monitor.semantics: http(s) URL or script path; first successful sample baselines, unchanged suppresses, change wakes the agent.

monitor_script.semantics: Legacy stored script monitor alias; model-facing monitor is canonical.

monitor_url.semantics: Legacy stored URL monitor alias; model-facing monitor is canonical.

declared_schema.description: Optional human-friendly name

name.semantics: Optional saved label; blank falls back to prompt/skill/script-derived text.

declared_schema.description: True = no LLM: the scheduler runs `script` (required) on schedule and delivers its stdout verbatim; empty stdout sends nothing (watchdog pattern). Use for script-only pings with fixed output; keep False for anything needing reasoning.

no_agent.semantics: Requires script; stdout is the result, empty stdout sends nothing, nonzero/timeout is an error.

declared_schema.description: Create only: persist disabled atomically. Resume to schedule; explicit run remains available. Default false.

paused.semantics: Create-only disabled state; explicit run remains available.

declared_schema.description: Create only: auditable reason; requires paused=true.

For create/update. ONLY set when the user explicitly asks to pin (or unpin) a job's model. pinned=true locks the CURRENT main agent model (and its provider) onto the job so later `/model` changes never touch it; pinned=false releases the lock so the job follows the main agent model again. Never set it on your own initiative: by default jobs follow the main model.

pinned.semantics: True snapshots the current operator provider/model; false clears the pin; no separate pinned field is stored.

declared_schema.description: For create/update: the full self-contained prompt (when it runs goes in 'schedule'; data windows like 'since yesterday' stay here; paired with any skills as the task instruction). For run: optional transient context for that single fire (never persisted).

prompt.semantics: Full self-contained job instruction; run uses it as transient one-fire context.

provider.semantics: Operator/programmatic inference provider; never forwarded by the model handler.

reason.semantics: Handler-only pause/cancel reason; absent from the declared model schema.

reasoning_effort.semantics: Operator/programmatic inference effort override; absent from the model surface.

declared_schema.description: Optional number of runs, after which the job completes (e.g. 'every day at 8am' + repeat=3 = the next three mornings). Omit for defaults (once for one-shot, forever for recurring).

repeat.semantics: Omitted is forever for recurring and one for one-shot; numeric strings normalize; non-positive becomes forever in the oracle.

declared_schema.description: REQUIRED for create. Schedule forms: (1) recurring interval — '30m', 'every 2h', 'every hour' (EVERY 30 minutes / 2 hours / hour, forever by default); (2) explicit one-shot by duration — 'in 30m', 'in 2h' (fires ONCE that far from now; use this for 'remind me in N minutes' — do NOT hand-compute an absolute timestamp); (3) natural day/time — 'every monday 9am', 'weekdays at 9am', 'every day at 9am' (recurring weekly/daily); (4) cron syntax — '0 9 * * *' (daily 9am); (5) absolute one-shot — ISO timestamp '2026-06-01T09:00:00'.

schedule.semantics: Parsed to once, interval or cron before persistence; bare durations recur and 'in <duration>' is one-shot.

declared_schema.description: Optional script run each tick; stdout is injected into the agent's prompt as context (with no_agent=True the script IS the job). Relative paths resolve under the profile SOURCE_PROJECT_HOME/scripts/; .sh/.bash via bash, else Python. On update, '' clears.

script.semantics: Relative file under the source project's scripts directory; stdout feeds the agent unless no_agent is true.

session_id.semantics: Internal background-run completion routing key, not a model field.

skill.semantics: Legacy singular skill alias; canonicalized into ordered unique skills.

declared_schema.description: Optional ordered skill names loaded before the cron prompt. On update, [] clears.

skills.semantics: Ordered unique skill names loaded before the job prompt; [] clears on update.

declared_schema.description: Optional IANA zone (e.g. 'America/New_York') the cron expression is read in, instead of the profile's. On update, '' clears.

timezone.semantics: IANA zone for recurring wall-clock schedules; empty clears on update.

declared_schema.description: Optional absolute existing path to run the job from: injects that directory's AGENTS.md/context files and anchors terminal/file tools there. On update, '' clears.

workdir.semantics: Absolute existing directory anchoring tools/scripts; relative and missing paths reject.

declared_schema.description: Per-job override for the 'Cronjob Response: <name>' header and 'To stop or manage this job...' footer around delivered output. 'on' wraps; 'off' delivers the raw output verbatim (useful for briefings meant to read clean); 'inherit' removes an override so the job follows the global cron.wrap_response again. Omit to leave it unchanged (a new job inherits).

wrap_response.semantics: on/off/inherit maps to true/false/null for delivered framing.

leo_field_adaptations.script: operator-allowlisted executable path, opt-in, args supplied by operator provisioning rather than a new model field
leo_field_adaptations.no_agent: distinct native script-only execution with durable evidence
leo_field_adaptations.monitor: existing egress-checked HTTP client or restricted script runner; no headers/cookies/private targets
leo_field_adaptations.context_from: latest completed native task outputs, cycle rejection and bounded injection
leo_field_adaptations.continuity: bounded own previous completed output with a first-run note
leo_field_adaptations.enabled_toolsets: intersect the agent allowlist; [] means no tools
leo_field_adaptations.skills: freeze a creation-time documentation snapshot and inject it at run time
leo_field_adaptations.wrap_response: control delivered text and include it in the edit fingerprint
leo_field_adaptations.workdir: anchor tools/scripts inside LEO allowed roots; not an OS chroot
leo_field_adaptations.attach_to_session: create/use a durable native job conversation and expose a compact next-reply brief
leo_field_adaptations.pinned: store operator-owned provider/model; missing target fails closed with needs-you
leo_field_adaptations.grace_minutes: operator/programmatic-only late-run policy; model requests are rejected
